title: Intake KPI Safeguards and Owner Playbook
summary: Lightweight playbook for accepting new model variants into Redwood serving. Focused on measurable KPI safeguards, short smoke suites, clear owner responsibilities, and a minimal rollout plan to reduce blindspots during early production adoption.
acceptance_criteria: Functional correctness: model answers >= 90% of canonical prompts (task-specific golden set) within tolerance band
Latency: 95th percentile single-request latency <= 350ms for common short prompts on the target instance type
Throughput: sustained tokens/sec within 20% of benchmark for the model family on the same infra profile
Cost: per-token inference cost must not exceed 1.5x of current baseline model for same utility; recommended threshold 1.2x unless approved
Quality regressions: no >3% absolute regression in any prioritized evaluation metric (accuracy/F1/ROUGE/BLEU/embedding-similarity) compared to pinned baseline
Safety/Hallucination: hallucination or fabricated-fact rate <= 1% on the validation probe set for structured tasks; for open-generation tasks, no higher measured harm signals than baseline
Determinism/variance: model response variance on seed-controlled probes within expected envelope (manual review pass required for outliers)
smoke_tests: Sanity generation: 20 short prompts covering greetings, task instruction, and edge cases — check for runtime errors and obvious tokenization failures
Prefix cache warmup: send repeated prefixes to validate KV cache behavior and ensure latencies drop after warmup
KV eviction scenario: large context concatenation test to exercise cache eviction thresholds
Streaming cutover: start stream and cancel mid-generation to validate graceful cancellation and no leaked GPU allocations
Embedding consistency: 50 sample sentences compared against baseline embedding cos-sim distribution; flag mean cos-sim < 0.88
Rate-limit handling: burst of 500 small requests to validate rate limiting and backpressure behavior on dedicated pool
probe_prompt_strategy: Construct 3 tiers of probes: core functional golden set (50 items), adversarial edge cases (40 items), user-realistic long-context probes (30 items)
Ensure at least 30% of probes use real customer anonymized examples when available (consult privacy leads)
For each probe include expected canonical answers and soft-evaluation heuristics (semantic match, slot-level correctness)
Label probes by signal type: correctness, hallucination, toxicity, latency sensitivity, cost sensitivity
regression_gates_and_actions: Gate A (smoke): fails if any smoke_test returns runtime errors or 95th latency > 500ms; auto-block onboarding
Gate B (metric): fails if any acceptance_criteria metric misses threshold; triggers remediation sprint and owner-led triage
Gate C (safety): any safety signal above baseline triggers immediate hold and notifies security/compliance
Fail action: rollback to last pinned model in staging, capture failing probes, assign bug owner with 3 business day SLA to provide fix or mitigation
Escalation: after 72 hours with no mitigation, escalate to eng-applied-ml manager and product owner; after 1 week, schedule executive review
owner_responsibilities: Model owner (primary): packaging, providing benchmark harness, mapping of golden probes, runbook for model-specific configs
Evaluation lead: curate probe sets, run automated evals, produce regression diff report and TLDR
Infra contact: provide cost/latency benchmark runs on target infra profile and sign off infra suitability
Security reviewer: run safety checklist, review PII risk on probe sets and model outputs
Release owner: author rollout policy (canary sizes, ramp cadence, fallback rules) and coordinate Dedicated patch if needed
minimal_rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Staging: full smoke suite and automated metrics; pin successful models as staging candidates. Phase 1 - Canary: 5% traffic (or dedicated 1-A instance equivalent) for 48 hours monitoring latency, error rate, and user-visible metrics. Phase 2 - Ramp: 25% for 3 days with expanded probe monitoring and customer-sample validation. Phase 3 - Full: 100% after 7 days stable and signoff by owner + infra + security. Always keep rollback policy and fallback variant pinned in route config.
metrics_dashboard_requirements: Expose per-model: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, error rate, request size distribution
Expose quality: probe pass rate by signal type, embedding drift score, hallucination incidents logged
Cost: per-request token cost, per-second GPU utilization by model variant
Regression diff: time-series of key eval metrics with annotation for model promotions/releases
risk_mitigation_controls: Automatic fallback: route to compatible baseline variant when latency SLOs violated or error spikes > 2x baseline
Conservative canary sizing: default to small traffic windows and progressive ramping with human approval for >25% moves
Traffic shadowing: run new model in shadow for heavy-production workloads to collect non-disruptive signals before canary
Prompt holdout monitoring: keep 10% of critical customer prompts on a fixed holdout to detect silent regressions
Alerting: high-severity alerts for safety signals routed to on-call security + model owner
fast_checks_for_oncall: Run smoke_tests quick script (./scripts/smoke-run.sh) — expected pass within 6 minutes
Check dashboard p95 > 350ms? if yes, trigger immediate fallback
Search recent logs for 'invalid-kv' or OOM patterns and tag owner
Verify canary traffic percentage matches rollout policy; if mismatch, pause routing and notify infra
notes_to_self: Keep probe set ownership light-weight: avoid >200 manual items at intake. Aim for a 120-item canonical probe pack (50 core, 40 edge, 30 long-context). When in doubt, prioritize observable user impact signals (latency, error, hallucination) over macro metrics. Remember to anonymize any customer examples and consult privacy before including. This doc is a pragmatic, minimum-risk contract — we can expand into full PRD if adoption warrants.
next_steps: Owner to attach golden-probe CSV and baseline run artifacts to linked_artifacts and reply to this doc within 3 business days
Evaluation lead to schedule a 30-min intake review with Infra and Security within 5 business days
Create JIRA intake ticket with 'intake:kpi-contract' tag and link smoke test CI in PR
